# OpenSCAD (WebAssembly build)

`openscad.js` and `openscad.wasm` are the official OpenSCAD WebAssembly build
`OpenSCAD-2026.11.26-WebAssembly-web.zip` from https://files.openscad.org/snapshots/
(SHA-256 `35ff8ba0c56f9f5bee6fa5e99cc1fa8f92df02c6ff306671ea009c35e6469732`), unmodified.

OpenSCAD is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later.
Source code: https://github.com/openscad/openscad (licence: https://github.com/openscad/openscad/blob/master/COPYING).
The rest of rigidflex only runs this program on its own `.scad` files; it is not part of OpenSCAD.
